newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Dec prod/import prices down 2.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Dec prod/import prices down 2.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The combined index for Swiss producer and import prices rose 0.1 percent in December to stand 2.2 percent lower than a year earlier, the Federal Statistics Office said.
On average, producer and import prices fell 2.4 percent in 1996 from 1995, the office added.
Note - The combined producer/import price index replaced the wholesale price index in May 1993.
The office also detailed the producer price index:
The office said the decline in 1996 prices represented the first significant drop since 1987. The price level had risen from 1988 to 1990 and then remained stable from 1991 to 1995.
On average producer prices in 1996 were 1.8 percent lower than the previous year.
